visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Filter keeps the duplicates
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The page should show each number once, but it only shows the repeated ones. The test in the filter is the wrong way round.

solution.explanation: indexOf gives the position of the first match. An item is the first of its kind when its own position equals that index. Not equal means it is a repeat, so the filter kept only repeats.
